title: CAL-MOS: Bridging Layers with Adapters for Robust MOS Prediction Across Speech Foundation Models
abstract: arXiv:2609.14956v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Speech Quality Assessment (SQA) is essential for modern speech technologies, and recent non-intrusive SQA predictors increasingly rely on Speech Foundation Models (SFMs). However, because SFMs expose representations from many layers, it remains unclear which depths are most informative for MOS prediction and how multi-layer information should be combined reliably across backbones and datasets. We benchmark ten SFMs on four MOS datasets under three regimes: full fine-tuning, last-layer probing with a frozen encoder, and naive cross-layer weighted aggregation. We find that the best layer is strongly backbone- and dataset-dependent, and that naive weighted fusion can be unstable across settings. We further evaluate a layer-calibrated aggregation variant that applies per-layer adapters before pooling, which improves the robustness of multi-layer fusion and narrows the gap to full fine-tuning while keeping the backbone frozen.

translated_title: CAL-MOS：通过适配器桥接各层，实现跨语音基础模型的鲁棒MOS预测
translated_abstract: 语音质量评估（SQA）对现代语音技术至关重要，近期的非侵入式SQA预测器越来越依赖语音基础模型（SFM）。然而，由于SFM会暴露来自多个层的表示，目前仍不清楚哪些深度对MOS预测最有信息量，以及应如何在不同的骨干模型和数据集之间可靠地组合多层信息。我们在三种机制下对四个MOS数据集上的十个SFM进行了基准测试：全量微调、使用冻结编码器的最后一层探测，以及朴素的跨层加权聚合。我们发现最佳层强烈依赖于骨干模型和数据集，且朴素的加权融合在不同设置下可能不稳定。我们进一步评估了一种层校准聚合变体，该变体在池化之前应用逐层适配器，这提高了多层融合的鲁棒性，并在保持骨干模型冻结的同时缩小了与全量微调的差距。
tldr: 该论文提出CAL-MOS方法，通过在池化前对每层应用适配器进行层校准聚合，解决了最佳层选择依赖骨干模型和数据集的问题，在保持骨干模型冻结的情况下提高了多层融合的鲁棒性并缩小了与全量微调的性能差距。
en_tdlr: The paper proposes CAL-MOS, a layer-calibrated aggregation approach that applies per-layer adapters before pooling, addressing the backbone- and dataset-dependence of optimal layer selection and improving multi-layer fusion robustness while keeping the backbone frozen and narrowing the gap to full fine-tuning.
